description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the HealthService class, focusing on database health checks using mocked database components.

classes.name: test_HealthServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for HealthService, testing various scenarios of database health check.

methods.name: checkDatabaseHealth_whenNoDataSource_returnsDown
methods.description: Tests scenario where DataSource is null, expecting the health check to report 'down' with an error message.

methods.name: checkDatabaseHealth_whenConnectionAndProbeOk_returnsUp
methods.description: Tests scenario where DataSource provides a valid connection and a successful probe, expecting the health check to report 'up'.

methods.name: checkDatabaseHealth_whenSelectProbeFails_returnsDown
methods.description: Tests scenario where executing the health check's SQL query throws an exception, expecting the health check to report 'down' with an error message.
